description: A state with no army, no tax and no territory that must keep real accounts: 2.6 billion of patrimony, a 44.5 million annual deficit, a billion of unfunded pensions. Six internal forces, each on its own ground. In law you decide alone; what resists is the apparatus, legitimacy and time.
heroSubtitle: Rome, 1 September 2026. You have been elected, and the books are open.
name: The Holy See
subtitle: Governing without an army or a tax
